2609.03820.title: Select, Compress, Reinvest: A Controlled Study of Visual-Token Allocation in Long-Video MLLMs
2609.03820.paper_summary: Long-video language models cannot look at every frame: an hour sampled once per second is 3,600 images, and a system keeps only a small fixed slice of that pool. Which frames survive that slice is usually treated as a preprocessing detail; we test whether it should be. Published selectors make the comparison hard because they change the frame scorer, the prompt boundary, the resolution policy, and the answering model all at once. We hold each fixed and vary one decision at a time: selection, spatial compression, and reinvestment of the savings, across six training-free selection rules, three long-video benchmarks, and two answering models. Selection is the largest single lever: on LongVideoBench's hour-long bin, eight query-selected frames beat sixteen uniformly spaced ones by 6.9 points, and Orthogonal Matching Pursuit, an unmodified decades-old sparse-approximation algorithm, matches or comes within a point of every purpose-built selector we compare it against, across all three benchmarks. Compression is close to free: halving each frame's spatial budget at fixed timestamps costs at most 0.44 points. Reinvestment is where that budget turns back into accuracy: spending the freed tokens on twice as many compressed frames, at a measured cost no higher than the original eight, returns a further two to three points; compression only pays off once its savings are spent this way. Along the way, an implementation bug in our own AKS baseline and a 0.07 to 3.74 point gap between two harnesses running the same published rules at the same budget show why these comparisons need to happen inside one controlled harness rather than across papers.
2609.03820.paper_summary_zh: 長視頻語言模型無法查看每一幀：一小時每秒取樣一次是3,600張圖像，而系統僅保留這個池中的一小部分。哪些幀能夠存活下來通常被視為預處理的細節；我們測試這是否應該如此。已發表的選擇器使比較變得困難，因為它們同時改變幀評分器、提示邊界、解析度政策和回答模型。我們保持每個固定，並一次變更一個決策：選擇、空間壓縮和節省的再投資，涵蓋六個無需訓練的選擇規則、三個長視頻基準和兩個回答模型。選擇是最大的單一杠杆：在LongVideoBench的一小時長的區間中，八個查詢選擇的幀比十六個均勻間隔的幀高出6.9分，而正交匹配追求（Orthogonal Matching Pursuit）這個未經修改的幾十年歷史的稀疏近似算法，與我們比較的每個專門構建的選擇器相匹配或相差不超過一分，涵蓋所有三個基準。壓縮幾乎是免費的：在固定時間戳下將每幀的空間預算減半最多只損失0.44分。再投資是這個預算轉回準確性的地方：將釋放的標記用於兩倍數量的壓縮幀，所需的成本不高於原始的八個，能再獲得兩到三分；壓縮只有在這種方式下花費其節省時才會有回報。在這個過程中，我們自己的AKS基準中的實現錯誤和兩個在相同預算下運行相同已發表規則的裝置之間0.07到3.74分的差距顯示了為什麼這些比較需要在一個受控的裝置內進行，而不是跨論文進行。
2609.03820.author: Prakhar Khatri et.al.
